items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Gay I think was the best Swing band that I had played with up until then.

ctx.x: Yeah. He didn't pay too much, but I'd just write because I could hear my music played, and I needed the experience anyway. I just kept writing for him until Leonard Gay, I know you heard of him...
